trello.desc: Hassan to write a proper incident write-up covering the raw attacker ticket, what the ticket summarizer actually did, timestamps, and a severity assessment, then file it in the security log. Due this week.

trello.name: Harden ticket summarizer pipeline against prompt injection
trello.desc: Wren to add a sanitization layer in the ticket parser: delimit quoted customer content and treat it as data, strip or neutralize instruction-like content, add a regression test feeding the exact attacker ticket through and verifying the summary stays clean, and add an eval that runs a small suite of injection attempts against the summarizer on every deploy. The eval is folded into this same task.

trello.name: Investigate jdoe443 account and password reset email delivery
trello.desc: Wren to check whether jdoe443 is a real account and whether password reset emails are not arriving for anyone, by reviewing reset email delivery logs for the last week and following up on the account. If the account is a burner, close it; if resets are actually broken, that becomes its own incident.

trello.name: Provide list of new service accounts since May for quarterly access review
trello.desc: Hassan to send Grace the list of service accounts created since May, to support Grace's quarterly access review. Due by Thursday.

trello.name: Run quarterly access review
trello.desc: Grace to run the quarterly access review herself, due Friday, using the service account list provided by Hassan.
